profile.shortBio: A Computer Science graduate focused on web development. I have built practical skills through independent projects, creating interfaces, connecting APIs, and learning how systems work end to end. I am ready to begin my career and keep growing with a team.
fullBio: I am Ikhwan Ramadhan, a Computer Science graduate from Universitas Putra Indonesia “YPTK” Padang. My professional focus is software engineering, especially building web applications from frontend to backend. My Data Science concentration complements my academic background in data processing and analysis.

Most of my web development skills come from real projects and independent learning. By building a school portal, a property application, and a car showroom website, I learned to understand user needs, deliver features, and solve practical problems involving bugs, API integrations, database design, authentication, and deployment.

I applied my academic background to my thesis on tropical cyclone track prediction using an LSTM model. I tested multiple configurations, compared results, and evaluated performance before selecting an approach. My career focus remains software engineering.
I want to keep improving my web development skills, build stronger software engineering habits, and expand my technical knowledge through projects and hands-on work experience.
